FY2025 companyfacts shows revenue of 13769000000, a 37.4% operating margin and net debt to EBITDA of 6.06x on active multi-train construction (Plaquemines, CP2). The company's own Q4/FY2025 results announcement describes it as an American producer and exporter of LNG substituting for Qatari volumes, the role this link measures.
